verdict.rationale: Lovable's first-party docs say it ships a built-in backend (Cloud) that includes a database with no infrastructure setup, creates tables and schema from a chat description, wires the generated app to that backend, and offers an in-builder SQL editor. Together this covers provisioning and wiring without leaving the builder; community comments about the Supabase partnership are speculation, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that database provisioning and wiring work end to end as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder

citations.quote: Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
you get a production-ready environment from day one, without needing to set up Supabase separately
For direct database access, use the SQL editor at Cloud tab → SQL editor
it generates the signup and login pages, wires them to your backend, and protects user data with row level security.
